subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote http(s) identity avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain accepted only for non-Control-UI surfaces and be documented/validated as unsupported for Control UI rendering?
rationale: The remaining fix changes the public avatar contract plus CSP, browser network-fetch, privacy, and local avatar diagnostics behavior, so automation should not choose the policy silently.

options.title: Keep Local/Data-Only Control UI Avatars
options.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI help, docs, validation, and UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Add Same-Origin Remote Proxy
options.body: Render remote avatars only through a gateway-owned proxy/cache with explicit auth, MIME, size, caching, SSRF/privacy, and failure-feedback rules.

options.title: Allow Direct Browser Fetches
options.body: Let the browser load arbitrary remote avatar URLs directly, accepting a weaker image CSP and operator-browser privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep Local/Data-Only Control UI Avatars
recommendation.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI help, docs, validation, and UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history signal across the current avatar resolver, gateway Control UI route, CSP, and authenticated rendering decisions.
